ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register on Monday, November 28 at approximately 10:00 a.m. ProctorU may be used in this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Crop Sciences or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Industrial Engineering or Actuarial Science or Systems Engineering and Design major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, Senior, or Graduate I class standing.
